mapper.select: select id, scenic_area_id, feature_name, feature_type, geojson, status, deleted, create_time, update_time from scenic_geo_feature where id = #{id} and deleted = 0 limit 1

select id, scenic_area_id, feature_name, feature_type, geojson, status, deleted, create_time, update_time from scenic_geo_feature where scenic_area_id = #{scenicAreaId} and deleted = 0 order by create_time desc, id desc
